text:
Lina K: hey all :wave: first day — quick q: where do I ask for VPN and SSH access? also where's the right place to post a short intro and lunch plans?

Sam D: welcome! :tada: For infra stuff ping #eng-infra or @Jamie R. For provisioning/credentials use #help and tag the message with `access`. Intros are great in #new-hires — if you want casual chats/drop pics post in #random.

Jamie R: hey Lina — +1 to Sam. For SSH please generate an ed25519 key and paste the public key into the onboarding form: https://redwood.company/onboard. Mac quick command:```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "lina@redwood.com" && pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub```If you want VPN, reply here and I'll open the ticket (need employee id + location).

Lina K: thanks! I'm on a Mac — besides SSH, any must-install tools? do we do a dev VM or containers?

Devex Ben: install `docker`, `direnv` and `gcloud` if you plan to hit GCP. We use dev containers for most services: https://git.redwood.dev/dev-containers. Quick start:```git clone git@github.com:redwood/example && cd example && make dev```That will mount creds and start the app locally.

Priya S: Welcome Lina! :smile: HR orientation is at 2pm today — you should've gotten a calendar invite. For payroll/benefits questions DM me or post in #people-ops.

Onboard Bot: Hey @Lina K — to register your account with Slack apps run `onboard-bot register lina`. See `onboard-bot help` for other commands.

Lina K: running the register command now. one more thing — earlier a bot DM'ed me a bunch of links, is there a place to report noisy bots?

Sam D: If a bot is noisy, open a short thread in #devex or DM me and include a screenshot + timestamp. We'll adjust the bot's cadence/permissions.

Jamie R: created the VPN ticket (TKT-4472) — will update here when it's approved.

Lina K: awesome, thank you all :heart: Very helpful!

Sam D: any time — ping us if the `ssh-key` paste step errors out. :thumbsup:
